bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, through the hotel concierge, by email to hxarlechique@hotelxcaret.com or by phone. Dinner Monday to Saturday, with tables every 30 minutes from 6pm to 8pm. Seats are limited, so booking ahead is advised, especially in high season.
groups: A chef's table and private spaces for small groups are available.
dressCode: Formal or smart casual. Men must wear long trousers and closed shoes.
children: Adults only: Hotel Xcaret Arte is an adults-only hotel.
